Trainee Software Engineer

We are looking for a Trainee Software Engineer to join our engineering team.
This is a great opportunity for a fresher or recent graduate with a strong
foundation in computer science to grow into a full-time software development
role.

Responsibilities:
You will work on building features from scratch, maintaining existing
modules, and writing scalable, reusable, and reliable software. Strong
problem solving and analytical thinking skills are expected, along with
clear communication with the rest of the engineering team.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in Java and Python
- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts
- Strong understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Good grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts
- Experience with SQL and relational databases

Nice to have:
- Exposure to Git and GitHub
- Familiarity with REST APIs
- Interest in Machine Learning and Generative AI

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering (B.Tech) or a related
field.

Experience:
0-1 years of experience. Freshers are encouraged to apply.
